desc: Establish the prime-wise reduction: \(\lvert v_p(S_i)-v_p(S_{i+1})\rvert=v_p(A_i)\), with the gcd condition becoming per-prime minimum exponent zero.
Derive and verify the bounded per-prime weighted height DP, including the minimum-zero condition and zero-step handling.
Prove a sufficient exponent-height bound and total complexity for \(N\le1000,\ A_i\le1000\).
Implement factorization of all \(A_i\), collect occurring primes, and construct each prime’s edge-exponent array.
Implement the modular weighted DP, combine prime contributions, and validate against samples.
